verdict.rationale: API stability is a fair question for a GPU product, because buyers depend on its software stack (CUDA, drivers, NIM). The pack, however, has no documented API versioning scheme or deprecation policy. The only versioning signal is a CUDA 13.4 release mention, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
